card.name: Ending of capsule and bladder words
card.fires_on: The second part of a split word or noun that completes a term, most often 'ules' after 'Caps' in drug names, and also 'bladder', 'infusion', 'nuclei' or 'eggs'.

modes.label: Body and lab nouns
